about: Calibration data for a FICTIONAL animated story. Derived from public Solana data about a publicly reported allegation; our estimates only. Timing and clustering do not prove common ownership or intent. No wallet addresses, token mints, tickers, handles or names are included.

units.t: seconds relative to the public wallet's first buy (t=0)
units.price: SOL per token divided by the public buy's execution price (public buy = 1.0)
units.volume_sol: SOL traded on the venue in the 5-second bucket, rounded to 0.01
units.candle: 5-second OHLC; empty buckets are flat at the previous close with volume 0 (empty=true)

validation: every candle passes high >= max(open, close), low <= min(open, close), prices > 0

event_labels.token_launch: the token's creation transaction (inside the window only)
event_labels.side_candidate_C1..C5: recurring early buyers found by our own method (NOT a confirmed side wallet; NOT Bubblemaps' set)

audit_summary.note: Rounded figures from our own sample (two UTC days of the public wallet; 22 sampled tokens for co-traders). Our estimates, not findings of fact.

early_co_buyers.same_slot_as_public_buy: none of the candidates; two other wallets once
early_co_buyers.quick_exits_seconds_after_public_buy: 2 to 15 when the token did not run
early_co_buyers.lockstep: two pairs of candidates bought and sold in the same slot as each other on most tokens
